title: file: Don't tap the same frames twice in a live capture
description:
In a live capture, cf_continue_tail and cf_finish_tail can
add new packets to the packet list after cf_retap_packets
resets the tap listeners. If the existing capture file is
large, then the process_specified_records retap_packets can
take longer than the timer for adding new packets, and so
cf->count can change during retapping.

We don't want to tap those packets twice, both in retap_packets
and in add_to_packet_list, so when retapping limit our range
to the packets already in the capture file when we reset the
listeners.

Also, since we fail retapping in process_specified_records if
the read lock is set, go ahead and check that and fail before
resetting the tap listeners. Previously the tap statistics were
being left in an invalid state if we were in the middle of another
tap. The currently processed tap wasn't aborted, but the stats
were reset part of the way through.

Add a few other comments about read_lock.

Fix #18249
